title: Director, PV Energy & Performance Engineering
descriptionText: Position Description Origis is seeking a Director PV Energy & Performance whose primary responsibility will be modeling, analyzing, and optimizing plant performance for utility solar plus energy storage projects through all stages of the development lifecycle. The responsibility includes the technical evaluation of solar equipment and implementation of QA/QC programs for PV modules. This individual, reporting to the Sr. Director of Performance Engineering, will be a subject matter expert on our growing solar performance engineering team. The Director PV Energy & Performance is a regular, full-time position, and is eligible for our generous employee benefits package, including employer paid health insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions, and other great benefits. Key Responsibilities Management of PV production estimates for early to late-stage developments and proposals Work cross functionally to drive design optimization and identify project risks and mitigations Collaborate with technical and procurement teams to efficiently model and assess equipment optionality Perform technical due diligence on PPA documentation and M&A activities to support contract negotiation Participate in the review of EPC contractual exhibits and redlines to ensure alignment with energy model inputs and facility performance expectations Contribute to process development and initiatives aimed at furthering modeling team capabilities and accuracy Track and manage workflow of solar modeling team and proactively work with internal stakeholders to manage their expectations Implement QA/QC programs for the PV modules and the vendors manufacturing processes Works across the organization and with IE’s and OE’s to achieve consensus in the target energy outputs for the solar and solar plus storage projects Provide project ASTM-based performance testing support and troubleshooting technical input if underperformance is identified or suspected Track performance tasks and deadlines during project initial energization and commissioning through substantial completion and handover to O&M Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or equivalent 8+ years of experience in solar energy modeling and optimization. Position may be filled at Sr. Manager level with 5+ years of relevant experience. Knowledge of solar resource data sources, system loss factors, and competency in modeling tools and best practices for utility scale PV system production assessments Demonstrated high proficiency in PVsyst is a must. PVcase, Python, PVLIB, MS Excel experience a plus Deep understanding of PV technology such as PV modules, inverters, and SAT racking Experience with PV project ASTM-based performance testing protocols desired Experience in implementing QA/QC program of PV modules desired Familiarity with battery energy storage systems (BESS) is a plus Key Attributes for Success Strong written and verbal communication skills Excellent organizational skills and time management skills. Excellent attention to detail Ability to perform in a high-growth, fast-paced, collaborative work environment Team player; ability to work with multidisciplinary team Ability to work with all levels of management, external consultants and various functional teams Strong organization, problem-solving, diligence, and analytical skills Proven ability to handle multiple projects at once and meet deadlines Versatility, flexibility, and willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm Good judgement with the ability to make timely and sound decisions Location Miami, FL; Austin, TX; San Diego, CA, or Remote for the right individual Travel Up to 20% travel required as necessary Job Level Director (Subject Matter Expert) - no direct reports

title: Director or Manager, Business Development
descriptionText: Position Description The Director or Manager, Business Development position, reporting to the Senior Director Business Development, will drive the company’s growth as part of the Commercial & Industrial (C&I) team, responsible for building a strategic plan for the C&I U.S. market and executing on the plan by managing and growing key relationships with large, strategic C&I customers, consultants, and aggregators. The role involves working across all business units, including project development, power marketing, interconnection, and M&A, to develop clean energy solutions that enable our strategic customers to meet their sustainability goals via PPAs or other types of corporate investments. Experience with growing strategic partnerships, power purchase agreement negotiations, comfort, and experience with being the face of the company at customer meetings with an enthusiasm to build customer solutions, a strong knowledge of renewable project development, and customer relationship management is required. This role may also support Business Development for Origis with Utilities, Municipalities, and Cooperatives across the various markets in the U.S. The Director or Manager, Business Development is a regular, full-time position, and is eligible for our generous employee benefits package, including employer paid health insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions, and other great benefits. Key Responsibilities Cultivate, build, and strengthen our relationships with C&I and strategic customers as well as Utility, Muni, Coop customers to create opportunities for offtake potential and/or project development. In collaboration with the Grid Power Business Development team, define and execute the market-specific growth strategy by prospecting, relationship building, and identifying clean energy solutions to meet customer sustainability goals. Prepare RFP and bi-lateral proposals for both utility scale solar and energy storage projects. Negotiate term sheets, MOUs, power purchase agreements, and other commercial agreements with the necessary support and oversight of executive management. Have a working knowledge of solar and energy storage project development, including land, permitting, and interconnection processes. Understanding customers and Origis ESG goals and activities Follow project development activities and maturity for all projects proposed to customers. Manage vendors and project budgets through SAP system. Preferred Qualifications BS and/or BA, MBA preferred. Experience and deep understanding of the U.S. utility scale solar and energy storage markets. Experience in customer presentations and negotiations. 3-10+ years of increasingly progressive development / origination experience Experience in negotiating PPAs and/or VPPAs. Experience working for a renewables or energy storage developer or working for an investor-owned utility with experience working with renewable project developers or leading development activities at the utility. Preparation of market analyses and recommendations Experience with reviewing and providing inputs for renewables as well as energy storage financial models. Have exceptional communication skills. Have exceptional organizational skills. Experience with CRM platforms. Understanding of power marketing and Hub settlement structures (e.g., Basis Risk, Zero Dollar Price Floor, Day Ahead/Real Time) Understanding of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and how it applies to solar and energy storage projects (e.g., Production Tax Credit, Investment Tax Credit, Tax Credit Transfers) Key Attributes for Success Detail-oriented, highly organized. Customer Relationship Management Strategic thinker Creativity in problem solving. Ability to multi-task and manage tight timelines and budgets. Effective in managing multiple stakeholders and within cross functional team. Location Miami, FL | Austin, TX | San Diego, CA | Remote can be offered for the right candidate. Travel Up to 40% travel required, as necessary. Job Level Director or Manager – no direct reports

title: Director, Performance Engineering
descriptionText: Company Overview Origis Services, LLC is a rapidly expanding Operations and Maintenance provider in the United States. Our solar asset portfolio continues to increase at a near exponential rate, with a mixture of owner developed and constructed sites and third-party sites contracted, or already under management. Our goal is to provide a more inclusive service capability, driving out the large expenses that are normally passed through to the owner. Position DescriptionOrigis Services, LLC is seeking a Director of Performance Engineering (PE) to join the leadership team in our Technical Operations Department and who will report to our Senior Director, Technical Operations. This leader will build a team that enjoys ownership of sites, portfolio performance and all associated infrastructure, digital tools, data flows, partners, and visualization/reporting. Reporting to the Senior Director, Technical Operations, this role will have a hand in crafting the overall performance strategy for the organization and define the technical critical processes, systems, and tools that will allow the overall group to drive the highest value/MWh possible across all of our operating renewable energy assets. The Director of PE will have direct oversite and responsibility for all engineering and digital activities associated with operating assets. You will develop and lead fleetwide processes, strategy and direction while overseeing the development and implementation of all technical processes and procedures relating to performance. This role is responsible for the technical investment decisions that underpin that strategy, ultimately enabling the broader organization to deliver on its commercial and operational objectives. In addition, this role will aid in supporting overall Remote Operations Center (ROC) procedures developing a cohesive unit and building synergy between the ROC and PE. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the Performance Reliability and Engineering Team and ensure successful portfolio management of Origis’ operating assets, both PV and BESS Translate commercial and operational objectives into well-defined initiatives that integrate into the company and department business Direct oversite and responsibility for all performance engineering activities Develop and lead technology strategies and implementations Responsible for technical process and procedure development and the implementation at all levels Responsible in supporting technical investment decisions leading to efficiencies Ensure technical processes are documented and drive improvement organization wide Own and develop the commercial relationship with technical vendors Manage direct reports and provide leadership to advance the team’s effectiveness Review technical documents and acceptance test results and validate actual PV and/or BESS performance against base case finance assumptions. Perform analyses to evaluate the uncertainty of existing PV and BESS performance models Develop new and improved models and tools to reduce PV and BESS underperformance and streamline notification and direction of the Field Operations team. Required Qualifications: Proven technical leadership in the energy space and successful experience building and managing a technical team. Strong technical professional background in engineering, electrical design engineering, and/or project engineering role in the renewable industry Success in building and delivering on Performance and Engineering functions relating to operating wind/solar/battery projects Demonstrable experience defining team KPI’s to best meet corporate initiatives and developing supporting metrics to identify and track improvements to ensure target goals and objectives are met Familiarity with industry standard PV modeling software (i.e. PVSyst, PlantPredict, Helioscope, Fractal) Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in an Electrical Engineering or Mathematical Science required (Master’s preferred) Experience performing data analysis to improve fleet performance and reliability Experience driving the identification and resolution of product failures; working to optimize plant performance and directing performance projects with site technicians Knowledge of monitoring and communications protocols, substation equipment and utility meters, battery backup systems and inverters, SCADA and MET station equipment. Proficient in understanding asset design documentation, PV performance modelling and analysis Knowledge of monitoring, SCADA systems, controls, and logical integration Experience leading 3rd party software providers in onboarding, QA and implementation Management of technical contract scopes and partnerships with third-party providers Significant experience working with O&M subcontractors to locate and resolve system outages Physical Requirements Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times Location Austin, TX Travel Up to 20% travel required as necessary Job Level Director - will have direct reports

title: Director or Manager Project Engineering
descriptionText: Director or Manager - Project Engineering Position Description Origis is seeking a Director or Manager - Project Engineering who will be a dedicated resource, the technical lead, and main point of contact for all engineering and technical matters on our utility-scale solar and BESS projects nationwide, with a focus on the U.S. South-east region. This individual will lead and own all Project Engineering efforts at the pre-construction and construction project phases. These efforts will support the EPC Team during contracting, initiation of project financing, detailed engineering (30%/60%/90%/IFC), and commissioning engineering support. This role will be an individual contributor, reporting to the Senior Director of Project Engineering. The Director Project Engineering is a regular, full-time position, and is eligible for our generous employee benefits package, including employer paid health insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions, and other great benefits. Key Responsibilities Select, engage, coordinate, and lead all technical conversations with Owner Engineers (OE) Lead, manage, and guide (OE) throughout 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC designs and RFIs from EPC contractors. Manage and coordinate 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC design review with OEs / SMEs & Other internal reviewers ensuring evaluation of design risks/flaws, and Value Engineering (VE) opportunities impacting project design, energy yield, and project cost. Lead and coordinate all engineering/technical conversations meetings with EPC contractor & BESS supplier/integrator during the project execution phase. Familiarize with all technical exhibits/requirements/milestones in the LGIA, PPA ensuring EPC Team tracks milestone and deliverables. Inform and consult with the PMs to understand the commercial implications of technical changes to respective projects. Manage assembly of technical scope documents to support initiation of project financing. Provide technical support to Project Management and Finance teams during technical discussions with Independent Engineers (IE) throughout project financing. Provide engineering support during Projects commissioning. Support technical initiatives and adoption of technologies on projects. Contribute to refining and maintaining Origis design standards and technical specifications. Evaluate forward looking and innovative approaches for best in market design, technology, and cost/construction considerations. Establish and maintain relationships with external Owner's Engineers and external engineering consultants. Preferred Qualifications 7-10+ years' experience in utility scale PV and BESS design. PV and BESS constructability experience in multiple geographic regions Understanding of design optimization and maximizing values of utility scale solar and BESS projects. Knowledge of all PV technical disciplines (Electrical, Civil, Structural, SCADA, HV, etc.) Strong understanding of PV cost stack and how design considerations impact project LCOE throughout the project development and design process. Ability to effectively communicate between technical and commercial minded team members. Key Attributes for Success Strong written and verbal communication skills Excellent organizational skills and time management skills. Excellent attention to detail. Ability to perform in a high-growth, fast-paced, collaborative work environment. Proven business acumen skills Team player, ability to work with a multidisciplinary team. Ability to work with all levels of management. Strong organization, problem-solving, and analytical skills Proven ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines. Versatility, flexibility, and willingness to work within changing priorities with enthusiasm. Good judgement with the ability to make timely and sound decisions. Physical Requirements Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to fifteen (15) pounds at times. Job Level TBD (based on level of experience of successful candidate) Location Austin, TX or Miami, FL (preferred). (Remote/ hybrid location may be considered) Travel Up to 20% travel required, as necessary. title: Remote Operations Center Operator
descriptionText: Position Description Origis Services, LLC is a rapidly expanding Operations and Maintenance provider for solar and energy storage sites in the United States. Our asset portfolio continues to increase at a near exponential rate, with a mixture of Owner developed and constructed sites and third-party sites contracted, or already under management. Origis Service, LLC is looking to fulfill a Remote Operations Center (ROC) Operator role in Austin, Texas and reporting to the ROC Supervisor/Manager. Key Responsibilities: Monitors performance of solar power plants and BESS/storage systems Rotating shifts for constant 24/7 monitoring and evaluation of system conditions Coordination of planned and emergency maintenance from ROC Recognize abnormal system operating conditions and respond timely to field upset conditions and alarms Accountable for safe, reliable, and compliant daily operations for all sites Complies with applicable NERC standards and procedures Ability to assess risk and resolve problems in a timely manner Report, log, analyze and maintain accurate records of system conditions Performs other duties as assigned Preferred Qualifications: Two-year college degree in Electrical Technology, other engineering related degree, or 1-3 years relevant work experience NERC System Operator Certification is a plus SCADA systems knowledge, familiarity with ERCOT ISO operating requirements preferred Experience demonstrating skill handling multiple tasks simultaneously at various stages of completion Demonstrate performance toward operational excellence Ability to communicate detailed information accurately to internal and external customers Remote work is not available for this position This position requires mandatory overtime outside of the embedded shift work as needed Must be willing to work all shifts, weekends and holidays on a rotating 12-hour basis Ability to pass a background check Location Austin, TX Job Level Operator
